title: 32 km inversion, 30 L-BFGS-B iterations under full_mumps after a full_mumps ramp, one taped form for the run
mesh: antarctica_320000_32000_buffered0 (Quartz's .msh, sha256 fd66fc42; 6,282 vertices, 9,055 cells), DG0 geometry, vertex raster sampling
initial_state: cold start: u = 0.1 u_obs, theta = phi = 0, the n,m 1 to 3 ramp under full_mumps, then ISMIP7_EVAL_CONTINUATION=0
forcing: MEaSUREs v2 450 m (sha256 268be94e) and BedMachine v4.1 (sha256 6bd08dbb); ISMIP7_FLUIDITY_PRIOR=legacy; no dH/dt term
site: IU workstation (Mac, 16 cores, 128 GB), data under /Volumes/LaCie/Data/antarctica_general/ismip7_obs; alone on the machine (no other session's process in a 10 s CPU log)
resources: 8 ranks; RSS a rank (mean over ranks) 998 MiB after the first taped solve, 1014 MiB after the last; peak 1387 MiB
cost: 161 s for 30 iterations (32 evaluations): 4.62 s an evaluation (median after the first), 4.18 s forward and 0.34 s adjoint; 136 s in the taped solves
audit: the same 30 iterations and 32 evaluations as test-32km-inversion-reuse-full-mumps-before, every objective within 1.6e-11 of it; published residual 1.02e-3; no forward failed
notes: isolates the single taped form under full_mumps (5.56 to 4.62 s an evaluation), whose recorded solve is tlm_adjoint's own; run under the probe wrapper of test-32km-inversion-ramp-blocks-before
